XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Engine

  • Device: Vibration damper

  • Fault: Irregular operation, vibrations and noise (squealing) from the engine

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: One or more of the following errors:
    • 2A1100 (Alternator malfunction)

    • 210601 (Alternator 2 malfunction)
  • Cause: Faulty vibration damper

• Action: Check the condition and correct functioning functioning the following components: auxiliary belt, vibration damper, alternator. If necessary, replace any defective components.
